title.value: Comparison of multi-center MRI protocols for visualizing the spinal cord gray matter
title.justification: The given paper title accurately describes the main research focus, which is the comparison of different MRI protocols for visualizing spinal cord gray matter.
title.quote: Comparison of multi-center MRI protocols for visualizing the spinal cord gray matter

extractions.description: The paper compares various MRI protocols at different field strengths to assess their effectiveness in visualizing spinal cord gray matter. Researchers collected data across multiple imaging centers and evaluated the protocols using both qualitative and quantitative methods. They proposed quality assessment criteria and metrics for gray matter imaging and provided open-source tools and data to aid future protocol optimization.
